biography.plain_text: Salvatore Trifirò is an Italian employment lawyer and co-founder of Milan-based Trifirò & Partners. Raised in Sicily, he moved north with financial help from relatives and trained with civil lawyer Cesare Grassetti. He developed a corporate employment practice before establishing the partnership with colleagues, continuing to advise companies and their executives.

long_biography.plain_text:
At 91, employment lawyer Salvatore Trifirò began competing in sprint races after encouragement from his trainer, Valerio Gaudio. An Italian masters title led to international competitions; in Florida, he won a world indoor silver medal in the 60 metres for men aged 90–94. Training became part of a working routine: gym sessions in the morning, followed by time at the office and afternoon track work at Milan's Arena.

His legal work still involved discussing new cases with partners and searching for solutions. He also turned to memoir, writing Volevo fare il viceré over nine months and revisiting his childhood and professional life.
